summary: Cannon Beach is a picturesque Oregon coastal town renowned for its dramatic Haystack Rock, pristine sandy beaches, and excellent photography opportunities. This charming destination offers a perfect blend of outdoor adventures, fine dining, and peaceful relaxation amid coastal natural beauty.

restaurants.name: The Irish Table
restaurants.description: Upscale farm-to-table restaurant featuring local Pacific Northwest ingredients with creative seasonal menus. Intimate atmosphere with excellent wine pairings.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared Dungeness crab with local mushrooms

restaurants.name: Newman's French Restaurant
restaurants.description: Classic French fine dining with ocean views and impeccable service. Specializes in fresh seafood and traditional French techniques.

restaurants.name: Pelican Brewing Company
restaurants.description: Beachfront brewery with fresh craft beers and casual coastal fare. Perfect for watching sunsets while enjoying local brews.
restaurants.mustTry: Kiwanda Cream Ale with fish and chips

restaurants.name: Sweet Basil's Cafe
restaurants.description: Charming local café known for fresh pastries, quiches, and excellent coffee. Popular breakfast and lunch spot with outdoor seating.
restaurants.mustTry: Basil scrambled eggs with smoked salmon

restaurants.name: The Irish Table Seafood Market & Restaurant
restaurants.description: Fresh-catch seafood restaurant with an attached market offering daily specials. Casual atmosphere with outdoor deck seating.
restaurants.mustTry: Fish and chips with local halibut

restaurants.name: Cozy Cabin Chowder & Seafood
restaurants.description: Rustic seafood shack specializing in clam chowder and fresh oysters. Casual counter service with cozy indoor seating.
restaurants.mustTry: Dungeness crab chowder in sourdough bread bowl

restaurants.name: Sleepy Monk Coffee Roasters
restaurants.description: Popular local coffee shop with house-roasted beans and pastries. Friendly atmosphere ideal for morning coffee before beach walks.
restaurants.mustTry: Single-origin pour-over coffee with fresh croissant

restaurants.name: Marco Polo Pizza
restaurants.description: Family-friendly pizzeria with wood-fired oven pizzas and casual Italian cuisine. Great for quick meals with beach scenery.
restaurants.mustTry: Clam and garlic pizza with fresh local seafood

restaurants.name: The Wayfarer Restaurant & Lounge
restaurants.description: Oceanfront dining with fresh seafood and steaks in a relaxed atmosphere. Known for generous portions and attentive service.
restaurants.mustTry: Grilled salmon fillet with seasonal vegetables

restaurants.name: Cannon Beach Bakery
restaurants.description: Local bakery offering fresh-baked bread, pastries, and sandwiches. Perfect for picnic supplies and casual breakfasts.

restaurants.name: Sea Pony Restaurant
restaurants.description: Historic beachfront restaurant with views of Haystack Rock and hearty coastal cuisine. Excellent for families and casual dining.
restaurants.mustTry: Oregon smoked salmon with fresh lemon butter

restaurants.name: Stephanie Inn Dining Room
restaurants.description: Elegant oceanfront restaurant with multi-course tasting menus and an extensive wine list. Romantic ambiance perfect for special occasions.
restaurants.mustTry: Pacific Northwest seafood tasting menu with wine pairing

activities.name: Haystack Rock Exploration
activities.description: Visit the iconic 235-foot sea stack and explore tide pools filled with starfish, anemones, and crabs at low tide. This is Cannon Beach's most photographed landmark.

activities.name: Cannon Beach to Arch Cape Hike
activities.description: Scenic coastal trail with ocean views, sandy beaches, and natural rock formations. Best done at low tide to walk along the shore.

activities.name: Ecola State Park Hiking
activities.description: Beautiful state park with multiple trails offering panoramic coastal views, old-growth forests, and wildlife spotting opportunities. Multiple difficulty levels available.

activities.name: Beach Sunrise Walk
activities.description: Peaceful early morning walk along the pristine beach watching the sunrise paint the sky while enjoying solitude and coastal serenity.

activities.name: Surfing Lessons
activities.description: Take advantage of Cannon Beach's consistent wave breaks with professional instruction suitable for all skill levels. Several local outfitters available.

activities.name: Cannon Beach Gallery Walk
activities.description: Explore the town's numerous art galleries, antique shops, and boutiques along the main street. Most galleries are free to browse.

activities.name: Sunset Picnic at the Beach
activities.description: Pack local supplies and enjoy a peaceful dinner watching the sunset over the Pacific Ocean from your private beach spot.

activities.name: Short Sands Beach Exploration
activities.description: Visit this protected cove perfect for families with tide pools, sea stacks, and calmer waters. Less crowded alternative to main beach.

activities.name: Nighttime Photography Tour
activities.description: Guided experience capturing the milky way, night skies, and long-exposure coastal photography with expert photographers. Seasonal availability.

activities.name: Coaster Theater Shows
activities.description: Local theater company offering musicals and plays in an intimate setting. Schedule varies seasonally with multiple productions yearly.

activities.name: Seaside Beach Bike Ride
activities.description: Easy bike trail connecting Cannon Beach to nearby Seaside with ocean views and coastal scenery. Rentals available locally.

activities.name: Storm Watching (Seasonal)
activities.description: Experience powerful winter Pacific storms from sheltered viewpoints with dramatic waves and weather photography opportunities. Best November to March.

spots.name: Haystack Rock at Low Tide
spots.description: Iconic sea stack with accessible tide pools, dramatic basalt columns, and perfect foreground elements for landscape photography.
spots.bestTime: Low tide mornings during golden hour

spots.name: Ecola State Park Overlook
spots.description: Elevated viewpoint showcasing dramatic coastal cliffs, ocean horizons, and layered landscape depth perfect for panoramic shots.
spots.bestTime: Sunrise or sunset for warm light

spots.name: Arch Cape Sea Arch
spots.description: Natural rock arch framing the beach with waves and distant headlands creating compelling compositional layers.
spots.bestTime: Low tide sunset with backlit waves

spots.name: Cannon Beach Main Street at Night
spots.description: Charming storefronts, street lights, and evening atmosphere providing excellent opportunity for night photography and street scenes.

spots.name: Tide Pools Detail Photography
spots.description: Close-up opportunities with sea stars, anemones, crabs, and other marine life creating vibrant macro photography subjects.
spots.bestTime: Low tide periods any time of day

spots.name: Sunset Along the Shoreline
spots.description: Continuous stretch of sandy beach with dramatic sky colors reflecting off wet sand creating stunning compositions.

spots.name: Weathered Driftwood and Rocks
spots.description: Scattered along the beach, these textured elements provide excellent foreground interest and compositional elements.

spots.name: Crescent Beach Seabird Colony
spots.description: Opportunity to photograph puffins, cormorants, and other seabirds in their natural habitat with ocean backdrop.
spots.bestTime: May to August during nesting season

spots.name: Historic Cannon Beach Pier (Seasonal)
spots.description: Reconstructed fishing pier offering leading lines to the horizon, reflections in shallow water, and structural elements.

spots.name: Tillamook Head Trail Overlook
spots.description: Elevated coastal vista with layered headlands, forest edges, and vast ocean creating depth and scale in compositions.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for expansive coastal landscapes and tide pool foregrounds
70-200mm telephoto for compressed ocean horizons and wildlife detail
24-70mm standard zoom for versatile general purpose shooting and street scenes
100mm macro lens for tide pool life and detailed natural textures
photography.goldenHourNotes: Cannon Beach's golden hour is exceptionally photogenic with warm light reflecting off wet sand and illuminating basalt rock formations. The low coastal sun creates dramatic shadows and silhouettes between 30 minutes before sunset through 15 minutes after. Spring and fall offer the most extended golden hour periods with lower sun angles, while winter storms provide dramatic sky conditions.

weather.seasonality: Summer (June-August) offers warm, dry weather ideal for beach activities with minimal rain and long daylight hours. Winter (November-March) brings frequent rain and storms but fewer crowds and dramatic coastal scenery perfect for storm watching and moody photography.
weather.summary: Cannon Beach experiences a maritime climate with mild, wet winters and cool, dry summers typical of the Pacific Northwest coast. Average temperatures range from 6°C in winter to 18°C in peak summer, making it suitable for year-round visits despite significant winter precipitation.

hotels.name: Ocean Lodge Hotel
hotels.description: Comfortable oceanfront hotel with direct beach access, hot tub, and complimentary continental breakfast near downtown shops and restaurants.

hotels.name: Hallmark Resort at Cannon Beach
hotels.description: Modern oceanfront resort with spacious rooms, fireplace suites, heated indoor pool, hot tub, and easy beach access with helpful staff.

hotels.name: Stephanie Inn Ocean Resort
hotels.description: Upscale beachfront resort offering in-room fireplaces, oceanfront views, fine dining restaurant, complimentary wine service, and personalized concierge service.
